name: Gustavo Petro
summary: Petro is a left-wing Colombian politician who campaigned and governed on tax, pension, labour and land reform, an end to new fossil-fuel exploration and a shift from the war on drugs. In speeches he links climate change, inequality and war to capital and calls for deeper participation, a reformed UN and global financial system.

universal-healthcare.rationale: He asked the UN why health should be a business rather than a right, and criticised vaccines treated as commodities.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: He told the General Assembly that the market leads to an abyss and that neoliberalism was mistaken from the start, and called for binding planning instead.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: The 2022 tax law he promoted made the wealth tax permanent on net assets above 72,000 UVT and raised taxation on top incomes and dividends.

abortion-legal.rationale: As candidate and after the 2022 court ruling he called abortion a free decision of the woman, not a crime, and congratulated those who fought its criminalisation.

sex-ed-in-schools.rationale: He said the education system must teach reproductive rights and equality, and that sexual education is a better path to protect life.

reduce-immigration.rationale: He condemned walls, machine guns, prisons and camps against migrants and said the solution is to restore water and nutrients to the South, not to enclose people.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: He proposed a new Security Council without vetoes whose decisions bind states, and said the UN must see that International Court of Justice rulings are enforced.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: He invited armies of other nations to defend Palestine and proposed a UN force to stop the Gaza killings, which rejects the view that intervention is never needed.

non-intervention.rationale: He called on states to send armed forces to protect Gaza, so he does not hold that outside powers may never intervene whatever the reason.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: He called climate change the mother of all crises and demanded public financing of a global transition off coal and oil.

human-caused-global-warming.rationale: He said the climate crisis was created by the smokestacks of the North and by capital's use of coal- and oil-fired engines.

existential-risk-priority.rationale: He urged ending wars and reforming global finance to defend life from extinction, calling the climate crisis the crisis of life.

future-generations.rationale: He framed climate action as defending life for children and grandchildren so they can live far from the apocalypse.

consumerism-harmful.rationale: He denounced the addiction to consumption and the insatiable compulsion to have and consume, mistaken for happiness.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: His government announced it would sign no new oil and gas exploration contracts while respecting existing ones, per press reports of the policy.

restructure-world-economy.rationale: He proposed reforming the global financial system, the IMF and multilateral banks to finance a Marshall Plan for climate and social justice.

sovereign-debt-cancellation.rationale: He said the debt of the poorest countries must be forgiven and proposed debt swaps for climate adaptation.

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.rationale: He argued that the richest 1 per cent fund campaigns, own media and dictate what may be said, leading to loss of liberty and democracy.

press-owned-by-wealth.rationale: He said global media owned by vast capital and the richest 1 per cent shape what can be said and silenced, but did not speak of press freedom as meaningless.

corporate-influence.rationale: He said the richest 1 per cent fund political campaigns and that powerful presidents obey them.

space-expansion.rationale: He described expanding life among the stars as humankind's mission, to be pursued once wars and the climate crisis are dealt with.

automate-paid-work.rationale: He said productivity, including from artificial intelligence regulated by public power, should mean free creative time for people.

civilians-legitimate-targets.rationale: He condemned the bombing of children and civilians in Gaza, Lebanon and Sudan as barbarism and genocide.

extrajudicial-killing.rationale: He condemned US missile strikes on suspected drug boats as killing poor young people without trial and said criminal cases should follow.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: He said there is no superior race and all of humanity is made in God's image, and that migrants are not criminals.

participatory-democracy.rationale: He said more democracy and participation, including binding regional dialogues, is how to overcome violence.

priority-to-poor.rationale: He said state spending belongs to ordinary people and those in need rather than political machines, and prioritised education, health and water in the budget.

gender-equality-agencies.rationale: He announced the creation of an Equality Ministry at his inauguration so that gender does not determine pay or safety.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: He said women earn less, do three to four times the care work and are under-represented in institutions, and that this must be corrected.

free-public-college.rationale: His campaign programme promised free public access to higher education for all young people, with the education budget raised from 4 to 14 trillion pesos.

separated-powers.rationale: His programme pledged to restore the balance and independence of the public powers and to build an independent judiciary.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: His programme moved the police to the interior ministry and replaced the riot squad rather than abolishing the police.

conscription.rationale: His programme made military service voluntary instead of obligatory.

job-guarantee.rationale: His government programme made the state employer of last resort for anyone who can and wants to work.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: His programme proposed smart tariffs and trade defence for vulnerable producers, while phasing out tariffs on inputs.

state-directs-investment.rationale: His programme made public first-tier banking a sponsor of business models with social and environmental returns.

widespread-small-property.rationale: His programme aimed to democratise space, credit and knowledge and turn idle large estates over to rural families.

individual-pension-accounts.rationale: The pension law he signed puts lower earners in the public Colpensiones pillar, with private individual accounts only for income above 2.3 minimum wages.

constituent-assembly.rationale: He formally asked to convene a National Constituent Assembly of popular initiative to revise the constitution.

direct-votes.rationale: He proposed a popular consultation so voters could decide labor and health reforms without intermediaries after Congress stalled them.

bypass-parties-groups.rationale: He said the people should decide without intermediaries and called supporters to mobilise against the Senate.

minority-territorial-autonomy.rationale: His decree lets Indigenous peoples set up territorial entities with their own government within the Colombian state.

indigenous-land-authority.rationale: His decree gives Indigenous territories authority over land use, with authorities' decisions binding on the state and private parties within their scope.

indigenous-internal-justice.rationale: His decree provides state support for the special Indigenous jurisdiction, under which communities apply their own law.

minority-language-support.rationale: He said students should study the languages of Colombia and proposed adding Indigenous and Afro-Colombian languages to school programmes.

nation-first.rationale: He told the General Assembly that the nation-state has reached its decadence and must give way to a united humanity acting through global democracy.

sacred-nation.rationale: He said the nation-state has reached its decline and that humanity, not the nation, is the new political subject.

ethnic-nation.rationale: He described migrants of all colours mingling into a single flow as a work of art and rejected any claim of a superior race.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: He presented the mixing of colours, cultures and clothes in migration as an amalgam to be welcomed and attacked hatred of the foreigner.

race-based-immigration-restrictions.rationale: He condemned immigration controls that treat migrants as an inferior race, saying there is no supreme race.

notes: Searched economy (tax, pensions, labour, jobs, land, tariffs), government (programme, constituent assembly, consulta popular), world (UN speeches 2022-2025, Israel, China), ecology (oil exploration, climate) and society (abortion, gender). Many society, liberty, culture and technology statements stay null because no stated position was found. Words and programmes are used only where no enacted record on the statement was found. His 2022-2026 record is partly known through secondary reports; the pension and labour laws were read through official or law-firm summaries.
